description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named SearchController, which exposes an API endpoint for searching receipt documents based on various criteria such as user ID, category, vendor, date range, and query text. It uses dependency injection to utilize the ReceiptService and processes incoming HTTP GET requests.

classes.name: SearchController
classes.description: A REST controller that provides an endpoint for searching receipts with various filtering options.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Handles GET requests to search receipt documents based on query parameters such as userId, query, category, vendor, date range, and pagination options. Constructs a SearchRequest object and calls the service to perform the search.
